name: B10-0190/2026 – § 2 – Am 9
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the enforcement of the Digital Markets Act
part_text: 2. Reaffirms the EU’s right to enforce its own regulatory framework based on legal and market-based criteria; stresses that transatlantic dialogue and cooperation with the United States remain of strategic importance, and that DMA enforcement should not be used as an instrument of economic or geopolitical confrontation; recalls that DMA obligations should apply to all designated gatekeepers equally, regardless of origin;
